verdict.why: In detected agent environments, a first deploy now skips the Worker name and workers.dev prompts and registers a project-derived subdomain automatically.

draft.detail: Wrangler automatically registers the project-derived workers.dev account subdomain on a first deploy when running in a detected agent environment.

test.error: FAIL: wrangler deploy in an agent environment did not register a workers.dev subdomain; it stopped asking the user to register one

source.quote: automatically registers the same project-derived workers.dev account subdomain on a first deploy when running in a detected agent environment.
